review_scope: All translation keys checked by the content auditor; all ten English and localized titles, flagged source/target pairs, and two deterministic long-passage samples reviewed. Currency insertions in numeric examples and escaped markup checked separately.

corrections.source: Suppose the live representative figures you write down for an illustrative exercise are 130 for freight and 4 for the basic packing in A, compared with 136 for freight and 11 for the more protective service in B. The totals are 134 and 147. The extra cost of B is 13, consisting of six more in freight and seven more in selected packing. If the 136 already includes the protective service, the calculation changes. The wording of the line matters as much as the numbers, which are fictional and do not describe HubBuy's price list.
corrections.translation: Suponha que você anote estes valores para um exemplo: na opção A, 130 de frete e 4 de embalagem básica; na opção B, 136 de frete e 11 de embalagem reforçada. Os totais são 134 e 147. A opção B custa 13 a mais, sendo 6 de diferença no frete e 7 na embalagem escolhida. Se os 136 já incluírem a proteção adicional, a conta muda. Leia a descrição de cada cobrança. Os valores são fictícios e não representam a tabela de preços da HubBuy.

corrections.source: Imagine the final parcel invoice is 162, the buyer uses 20 of account credit and the external card supplies the remaining 142. Checking only the card account might make the shipment look cheaper than it was. The invoice total still describes 162 of parcel charges. The payment history shows how that amount was settled. Record both pieces of information instead of replacing the invoice total with the smaller card debit.
corrections.translation: Imagine que a fatura final do envio seja de 162. O comprador usa 20 do saldo da conta e paga os 142 restantes com um cartão. Se olhar apenas o extrato do cartão, pode achar que o envio custou menos. A fatura registra o custo total de 162 e o histórico de pagamentos mostra como ele foi quitado. Registre as duas informações e mantenha o total da fatura separado do valor debitado no cartão.
